summary:
The teaching opens by naming where the letter left off last week, and stays with the second chapter throughout.

The speaker argues that the passage is short and easy to pass over on the way to something louder, and that everything which follows in the letter rests on what is said in it. The bulk of the teaching is spent slowing the passage down phrase by phrase before drawing it back together.

It closes by asking the congregation to read the chapter again before the following week.
description: A close reading of the letter's second chapter, and why everything after it depends on what is said there.
